name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Penne Pasta with Mild Tomato-Basil Marinara
whyItWorks: Tender semolina penne pasta tossed in smooth, mild tomato-basil marinara sauce and topped with parmesan cheese. Low-fat, low-residue, and soothing for tired stomachs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Penne Pasta with mild marinara sauce; add a side breadstick or dinner roll.
watchOuts: None; mild strained marinara is gentle
